src/WhatTheJack.cpp declares a GENERATE_BUTTON parameter and passes NUM_PARAMS to config, then never calls configParam for it and never adds a ParamWidget. The census shows one unnamed parameter and an empty paramPos, so the parameter exists in the module, has no ParamQuantity, cannot be turned, and cannot be clicked for help. It gets no line and no tag.

walkWidgetTree collects every PortWidget in the rack, filtering inputs by getTopCable so an occupied input is skipped, and applying no such filter to outputs. An output can therefore be given a second, third or twentieth cable.

The button is a CallbackButton (an SvgButton subclass) whose onButton handler fires on press rather than on release, so the cable appears the moment the mouse goes down.

The module has no inputs and no outputs at all.
